evidence: Touches src/policy/policy.cpp and carries the TX fees and policy label to modify standardness rules for Taproot annexes.
rationale: Permitting unstructured Taproot annexes in IsWitnessStandard expands transaction relay capabilities for standard mempools. The PR resolves the problem that 'Taproot annexes are currently treated as non-standard by mempool policy, preventing nodes from relaying or accepting standard transactions that utilize annexes'.
